About The Position

The Director of Engineering oversees the design, development, and delivery of manufactured devices for defense, aerospace, and industrial customers. This role leads the engineering organization, including staffing, employee development, and performance, and drives product development in line with customer specifications, budgets, and regulatory standards. The Director serves as a liaison across the organization, oversees internally funded R&D projects, supports proposal preparation, and presents technical content to customers and management. The role also advances AS9100 compliance and Lean/5S manufacturing principles and formulates engineering policies to improve competitiveness and profitability.

Requirements

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering.
* At least 5 years of experience in engineering or project management leadership.
* Knowledge of power/energy storage battery systems.
* Must be a U.S. Person.

Nice To Haves

* Master's degree preferred.
* DoD application experience strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with hazardous chemicals, robotics, and explosive materials.

Responsibilities

* Lead and manage the engineering organization, including staffing, development, and performance.
* Drive product development aligned with customer specifications, budgets, and regulatory standards.
* Serve as a liaison from frontline engineers to executive leadership.

## Full Job Description
The Vice President, Data Center Operational Readiness ensures Oppidan's data center facilities are designed, constructed, commissioned, documented, and transferred to operations in a manner that protects reliability, schedule, investment, and client expectations.
This role serves as Oppidan's technical representative across the transition from development and construction into operational use. The Senior Director establishes consistent commissioning, site-acceptance, turnover, and Day 1 readiness standards while holding consultants, contractors, commissioning agents, equipment vendors, and operating partners accountable for meeting Oppidan project requirements.

...

* Own Oppidan's data center commissioning and operational readiness strategy from design development through final acceptance, turnover, and warranty closeout.
* Establish practical, repeatable standards for commissioning, QA/QC, site acceptance, punch-list management, turnover documentation, operator training, and Day 1 readiness.
* Represent Oppidan's ownership interests during design reviews, construction, equipment startup, functional testing, integrated systems testing, and operational handover.
* Partner with development, design, construction, legal, finance, asset management, operating partners, commissioning agents, and customers to define acceptance criteria, responsibilities, schedules, and escalation paths.

...

* Identify commissioning, design, construction, documentation, and turnover risks early, then drive corrective actions to documented resolution.
* Hold design consultants, general contractors, commissioning providers, equipment vendors, and other project partners accountable for design intent, testing requirements, documentation quality, and contractual deliverables.
* Create clear executive reporting on commissioning status, unresolved deficiencies, operational readiness, schedule exposure, technical risk, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Capture lessons learned from commissioning, startup, and operations, then incorporate those lessons into design standards, procurement decisions, future project requirements, and delivery processes.
**Qualifications**
Required
* 10+ years' experience in delivering mission critical facilities, data centers, large industrial facilities or projects with similar complexity.
* Demonstrated ownership of commissioning, site acceptance, turnover, startup, operational readiness, or construction-to-operations transition programs.
* Proven ability to lead/communicate across development, design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, customers and executive team.

...

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, construction management, facilities engineering, or a related field.
* Professional engineering, commissioning, project-management, reliability, or mission-critical facility certification.
* Experience with both air-cooled and liquid-cooled infrastructure.
Additional Requirements
* Occasional travel to project sites may be required.
* Ability to visit active construction sites and comply with site safety requirements.
**Core Soft Skills**
